title: Non-unital monoidal category of contact manifolds and Legendrian correspondence
summary: There are two purposes of the present paper which are interrelated. The first goal is to construct the structure of a non-unital monoidal category $\mathfrak{Cont}$ of contact manifolds, not necessarily coorientable, by developing the contact topology \emph{without contact forms}. The non-unital monoidal product is the functorial contact product $\star$, called star product, introduced in \cite{oh:shelukhin-conjecture}.
